events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: Yepoda K-Beauty Pop-Up at Sephora Union Square
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's K-beauty Sephora launch pop-up with product trials, giveaways and gift-card/full-size-product prize opportunities.
events.what_is_free: Attendance and advertised freebies are free with no purchase necessary; gifts are while supplies last. Separate gifts-with-purchase require qualifying Sephora purchases.
events.caveats: Free gifts are while supplies last. Gift-with-purchase offers require the advertised $40+ or $60+ Sephora purchase. The organizer's Eventbrite listing is the actionable registration source.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, 12–6 PM at Sephora Union Square. No purchase is necessary to attend or receive the general advertised freebies.

events.event_name: Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen Mobile Pop-Up
events.brand: Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen
events.address: Multiple Manhattan stops; see date details
events.what_it_is: A mobile K-beauty and ice-cream activation celebrating Jung Saem Mool Beauty's Sephora launch, stopping at three Manhattan locations each day.
events.what_is_free: A special JSM Beauty × Van Leeuwen ice cream is offered to guests who follow @jsmbeauty_global; an Instagram Story/tag promotion offers a chance at a full-size Metal Lip Serum, limited to 200 units per day.
events.caveats: The ice-cream giveaway requires following @jsmbeauty_global. The lip-serum promotion requires the advertised Instagram tag/story action and is limited to 200 units per day. No advance RSVP requirement is published by the corroborating current sources.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 20 route: 11 AM–1 PM Lexington Avenue; 1:30–3:30 PM at 557 Broadway; 4–6 PM at 21–27 9th Avenue.

events.what_it_is: DedCool's first café-and-retail pop-up celebrating the Mocha Magic fragrance with café drinks, fragrance sampling, exclusive merchandise and gifts.
events.what_is_free: Fragrance sampling and a special gift for the first 50 guests in line each day; other merchandise and gifts-with-purchase are retail offers.
events.caveats: RSVP is explicitly not required and does not guarantee gift eligibility. The first-50 gift is first-come, first-served and while supplies last. Products and some gifts-with-purchase require purchase.
events.practical_notes: Open Sept. 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily. For the limited free gift, arrive early; RSVP does not reserve one.

occurrences.details: Free organizer registration is available. General advertised freebies do not require purchase and are while supplies last.
